paragraphs: PAIRIN sells My Journey, a platform for personalized workforce and education connections for students and job seekers. The company describes career and education matching, labor exchange and case management that connect the people an organization serves to careers, programs and jobs. My Journey is presented as connecting user data across systems for a unified learning and employment record with customizable workflows.

Packages include My Job Center, described as a one stop shop for employers and job seekers to connect. My Pro Center covers case management of eligibility, outcome tracking and warm hand off referrals to services and education programs. Within My Professional Center, career and academic counselors manage student career and academic plans, including college and career planning.

The home page places this work across workforce development, government and educational institutions. The about page describes workforce programs, government and education organizations delivering training, career guidance, job placement and community services through the platform.

quote.text: PAIRIN facilitates personalized workforce and education connections to foster rewarding and relevant journeys for students and job seekers.
